# ML Model Card (DisruptionIQ prototype)

**Training data: SYNTHETIC.** Generated by `simulate_history.py` from a hand-defined
delay process. Metrics show the pipeline recovers that process. They are not
evidence of accuracy on real shipments.

Rows: 3000  |  Features: 9  |  Split: 80/20, plus 5-fold CV

## Models
| Id | Task | Algorithm | Target |
|----|------|-----------|--------|
| C1 | Classification (binary) | Logistic Regression | breach (delay > 2h) |
| C2 | Classification (3-class) | Random Forest | risk band GREEN/AMBER/RED |
| R1 | Regression | Gradient Boosting | delay hours |
| R2 | Regression | Ridge | log(1 + penalty INR) |

## Limitations
- Relationships are defined by the generator, so high scores are expected and not meaningful.
- Not connected to any API route. Used offline for analysis.
- Retrain on real historical shipments before any operational use.
